title: StackSetting
description: One declared Stack setting as GET /stack/v1/settings serves it: a SettingsKey (spec/schemas/settings-key.schema.json, the same fields and constraints, restricted to scope `device` and lives_in `stack`) plus the Stack's three fields: whether the key takes effect only after a restart, the value in effect, and the pending value. Home's generic settings renderer draws the control from the SettingsKey half and reads and writes the value half; the Stack declares each key exactly once.

range.description: Selector-specific: {min, max} for number, {options: [{value, label}]} for select.

needs_restart.description: True when a change is held as `pending` until the service restarts.

in_effect.description: The value the daemon is running with. Shape depends on the selector.

pending.description: A stored value not yet in effect, or null.
